mapper.select: SELECT TAX_YEAR FROM DEDUCTION_TYPE UNION SELECT TAX_YEAR FROM TAX_BRACKET UNION SELECT TAX_YEAR FROM BENEFIT_CONDITION ORDER BY 1 DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEDUCTION_TYPE WHERE TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TAX_BRACKET WHERE TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BENEFIT_CONDITION WHERE TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear}) FROM DUAL

SELECT D.TYPE_ID AS typeId, D.TAX_YEAR AS taxYear, D.TYPE_CODE AS typeCode, D.TYPE_NAME AS typeName, D.DEDUCTION_KIND AS deductionKind, D.RATE AS rate, D.LIMIT_AMOUNT AS limitAmount, D.SALARY_MIN AS salaryMin, D.SALARY_MAX AS salaryMax, D.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, C.CATEGORY_NAME AS categoryName, D.PAY_METHOD AS payMethod, D.SOURCE_NOTE AS sourceNote, TO_CHAR(D.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt, D.UPDATED_BY AS updatedBy FROM DEDUCTION_TYPE D LEFT JOIN SPEND_CATEGORY C ON C.CATEGORY_ID = D.CATEGORY_ID WHERE D.TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear} ORDER BY D.DEDUCTION_KIND, D.TYPE_CODE, D.SALARY_MIN, D.TYPE_ID

SELECT BRACKET_ID AS bracketId, TAX_YEAR AS taxYear, BRACKET_TYPE AS bracketType, LOWER_AMOUNT AS lowerAmount, UPPER_AMOUNT AS upperAmount, RATE AS rate, BASE_AMOUNT AS baseAmount, SOURCE_NOTE AS sourceNote, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt, UPDATED_BY AS updatedBy FROM TAX_BRACKET WHERE TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear} ORDER BY BRACKET_TYPE ASC, LOWER_AMOUNT ASC

SELECT BENEFIT_ID AS benefitId, TAX_YEAR AS taxYear, BENEFIT_CODE AS benefitCode, BENEFIT_NAME AS benefitName, MIN_AGE AS minAge, MAX_AGE AS maxAge, MAX_MILITARY_MONTHS AS maxMilitaryMonths, COMPANY_SIZE AS companySize, SALARY_LIMIT AS salaryLimit, HOMELESS_HEAD_REQ_YN AS homelessHeadReqYn, REDUCTION_RATE AS reductionRate, LIMIT_AMOUNT AS limitAmount, PERIOD_YEARS AS periodYears, SOURCE_NOTE AS sourceNote, TO_CHAR(UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt, UPDATED_BY AS updatedBy FROM BENEFIT_CONDITION WHERE TAX_YEAR = #{taxYear} ORDER BY BENEFIT_CODE ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BENEFIT_CONDITION ( BENEFIT_ID, TAX_YEAR, BENEFIT_CODE, BENEFIT_NAME, MIN_AGE, MAX_AGE, MAX_MILITARY_MONTHS, COMPANY_SIZE, SALARY_LIMIT, HOMELESS_HEAD_REQ_YN, REDUCTION_RATE, LIMIT_AMOUNT, PERIOD_YEARS, SOURCE_NOTE, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( SEQ_BENEFIT_CONDITION.NEXTVAL, #{dto.taxYear}, #{dto.code}, #{dto.name}, #{dto.minAge, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dto.maxAge, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dto.maxMilitaryMonths, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dto.companySize, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.salaryLimit, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dto.homelessHeadReqYn}, #{dto.rate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dto.limitAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dto.periodYears, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{dto.sourceNote}, SYSDATE, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE DEDUCTION_TYPE SET TYPE_NAME = #{dto.name}, RATE = #{dto.rate}, LIMIT_AMOUNT = #{dto.limitAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SALARY_MIN = #{dto.salaryMin}, SALARY_MAX = #{dto.salaryMax, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SOURCE_NOTE = #{dto.sourceNote}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE TYPE_ID = #{dto.id}

UPDATE TAX_BRACKET SET LOWER_AMOUNT = #{dto.lowerAmount}, UPPER_AMOUNT = #{dto.upperAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, RATE = #{dto.rate}, BASE_AMOUNT = #{dto.baseAmount}, SOURCE_NOTE = #{dto.sourceNote}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE BRACKET_ID = #{dto.id}

UPDATE BENEFIT_CONDITION SET BENEFIT_NAME = #{dto.name}, MIN_AGE = #{dto.minAge, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, MAX_AGE = #{dto.maxAge, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, MAX_MILITARY_MONTHS = #{dto.maxMilitaryMonths, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, COMPANY_SIZE = #{dto.companySize, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SALARY_LIMIT = #{dto.salaryLimit, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, HOMELESS_HEAD_REQ_YN = #{dto.homelessHeadReqYn}, REDUCTION_RATE = #{dto.rate, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, LIMIT_AMOUNT = #{dto.limitAmount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, PERIOD_YEARS = #{dto.periodYears, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SOURCE_NOTE = #{dto.sourceNote}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{updatedBy} WHERE BENEFIT_ID = #{dto.id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DEDUCTION_TYPE ( TYPE_ID, TAX_YEAR, TYPE_CODE, TYPE_NAME, DEDUCTION_KIND, RATE, LIMIT_AMOUNT, SALARY_MIN, SALARY_MAX, CATEGORY_ID, PAY_METHOD, SOURCE_NOTE, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY ) SELECT SEQ_DEDUCTION_TYPE.NEXTVAL, #{targetYear}, TYPE_CODE, TYPE_NAME, DEDUCTION_KIND, RATE, LIMIT_AMOUNT, SALARY_MIN, SALARY_MAX, CATEGORY_ID, PAY_METHOD, SOURCE_NOTE, SYSDATE, #{updatedBy} FROM DEDUCTION_TYPE WHERE TAX_YEAR = #{sourceYear}

INSERT INTO BENEFIT_CONDITION ( BENEFIT_ID, TAX_YEAR, BENEFIT_CODE, BENEFIT_NAME, MIN_AGE, MAX_AGE, MAX_MILITARY_MONTHS, COMPANY_SIZE, SALARY_LIMIT, HOMELESS_HEAD_REQ_YN, REDUCTION_RATE, LIMIT_AMOUNT, PERIOD_YEARS, SOURCE_NOTE, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY ) SELECT SEQ_BENEFIT_CONDITION.NEXTVAL, #{targetYear}, BENEFIT_CODE, BENEFIT_NAME, MIN_AGE, MAX_AGE, MAX_MILITARY_MONTHS, COMPANY_SIZE, SALARY_LIMIT, HOMELESS_HEAD_REQ_YN, REDUCTION_RATE, LIMIT_AMOUNT, PERIOD_YEARS, SOURCE_NOTE, SYSDATE, #{updatedBy} FROM BENEFIT_CONDITION WHERE TAX_YEAR = #{sourceYear}
mapper.select: SELECT HISTORY_ID AS historyId, COLUMN_NAME AS columnName, OLD_VALUE AS oldValue, NEW_VALUE AS newValue, CHANGED_BY AS changedBy, TO_CHAR(CHANGED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS changedAt FROM CRITERIA_HISTORY WHERE TABLE_NAME = #{tableName} AND TARGET_ID = #{targetId} ORDER BY CHANGED_AT DESC, HISTORY_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY
